rules: Record the exact model name and the per-output price shown in Flow BEFORE Batch 1; set confirmed_in_flow_ui=true.
Set outputs per prompt to 1 in Flow settings. If Flow defaults to 2 outputs, each prompt costs double.
No automatic upgrade to a more expensive model or quality tier. A model change needs a new pricing record.
Reference/ingredient images generated inside Flow are charged to the primary pool (pool 'supporting_image'). Uploading existing stills is free.
The 100-credit reserve stays unspent unless the owner explicitly releases it (reserve_released_by_owner).
